Figure1: SafeOT-Dual unifies penalty and budget views through one joint flow solve. Soft budgets enter jointly; hard events remove graph edges. Clipped, filtered dual prices combine with realized-cost feedback before the actor update. Mini-plots illustrate possible leakage and oscillation, not experimental traces. Fixed penalties and Lagrangians are exact settings at c = 0; LP and saturated-clip endpoints are conditional limits.
Figure2: SafeOT-Dual transfers joint budget prices from a flow projection to a policy update. Rollouts provide empirical flows, advantages and realized costs. Soft budgets and excluded hard edges constrain one projection. Clipped, filtered dual prices combine with observed-cost feedback to price the PPO/TRPO advantage. Only prices reach the actor; the target flow is not executed. The feedback equation shows projected ascent; the implementation may use an adaptive optimizer.
